description: A month grid for picking a single date. Keyboard: Arrow keys move day, Page Up/Down move month, Home/End jump to the week's start/end, Enter/Space select. Month and weekday names come from Intl (locale + RTL aware). Standalone, or the body of <DatePicker>. Copy: the accessible name says what the date is FOR — "Delivery date", not "Calendar".

props.name: month
props.description: Controlled visible month; omit to let the calendar manage it.

props.name: rangeStart
props.description: Display a picked span (a DateRangePicker's selection): the edges read as selected and the days between get a soft band. Display only; clicks still report through onChange.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP-47 locale for month/weekday names. Defaults to the document language.
